chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Katib al-Iskafi, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim al-Maharibi, who reported from Ismail ibn Ishaq al-Rashidi, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl al-Azdi, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them, from his father, from his grandfather that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
'Surely, Allah is displeased when Fatimah is displeased, and He is pleased when she displays her pleasure.'

key_terms.فاطمة: Fatimah - the daughter of the Prophet, known as al-Zahra

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Allah's pleasure and displeasure being linked to Fatimah?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through an Imami chain from Imam al-Baqir back to the Prophet, affirms the exceptional spiritual station of Fatimah al-Zahra. The Prophet's statement that Allah's pleasure and displeasure are linked to Fatimah's establishes her infallibility (isma) and supreme status in Islamic theology, a foundational text for Shia belief in her unique rank.
